description: Make the quote from a draft once the worker decided every line. Only approved lines go on it, entered as the worker's. scope_of_work or notes on the draft is copied onto the quote as the written scope. Pass either here to set or replace it. The customer quote page and PDF show it. Do not include private worker notes. The quote is a draft: send it with quotes.send only when the worker says so.

notes.description: Written scope of work for the customer quote page and PDF. notes is the same field. Null clears it. Do not include private worker notes.
